rationale.transientDeviationMs: 10 ms is one third of a 30 fps project frame and below typical cut-timing perception; a larger shift means transients land on a different frame.
rationale.unexplainedTailMs: 20 ms is under one project frame at 30 fps; the intentional ceil-hold samples are subtracted and reported separately.
rationale.phaseDeviationMs: 0.2 ms is about ten 48 kHz samples; a larger change moves the stereo image audibly for transient material.
rationale.seamMaxDiffDb: -40 dBFS relative to peak is a 1% amplitude step at the join, empirically below an audible click in this material set; the click ratio additionally compares the boundary first difference with the same join in the whole-source render.
rationale.seamClickRatio: The joined first difference must not exceed twice the whole-source first difference at the same boundary.
rationale.chunkBoundaryClickRatio: Curve chunk joins are compared against the 99.5th percentile of the same output's first differences; twice that value is treated as a click.
rationale.chunkBoundaryJumpDb: An absolute -40 dBFS step check backs up the relative click ratio at chunk edges.
rationale.resamplePhase: Continuous resampling is expected to scale the inter-channel delay with the stretch factor; only deviation from that model is gated.
rationale.note: Thresholds are prototype gates for the built-in algorithm, not a final product spec. Failures are reported with measured numbers and alternative algorithms are costed in the report.
